subject: Intro & ops: Elena Kovalenko (AIWorks) — EMEA slot, rehearsal logistics
messages:
From: Dr. Elena Kovalenko <elena@aiworks.co>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: AIWorks Events <events@aiworks.co>; Tom R. <tom.r@aiworks.co>
Date: Sat, 14 Sep 2024 08:23:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Webinar — localization & rehearsal windows

Hi Marcus —

Great to connect. Thanks for the invite; I’m excited to join the Redwood webinar (EMEA slot). A few operational notes from our side so we can lock rehearsal/run-of-show: 

- Timezones: I’m based in Prague (CEST). My team prefers a dry run earlier in the week: Tue 2024-09-19 between 09:00–11:00 CEST or Wed 2024-09-20 14:00–16:00 CEST. Either works if you can confirm greenroom access.
- Slides: attaching a rough PDF of the deck I’ll present — we’ll finalize by Friday.
- Localization: we’ll need live captions in English + Spanish (audience mix includes Madrid & LATAM). Do you provide captioning?
- Tech: I’ll use my laptop + wired headset; Tom will be our producer (cc’d). He’ll also send our preferred lower-third for the intro.

Attached: speaker_bio.docx, slides-draft.pdf

Thanks — happy to adapt to your run-of-show.

Best,
Dr. Elena Kovalenko
VP of Product, AIWorks
[attachment: speaker_bio.docx (14KB); slides-draft.pdf (2.1MB)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Elena Kovalenko <elena@aiworks.co>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, AIWorks Events <events@aiworks.co>
Date: Sat, 14 Sep 2024 13:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Webinar — localization & rehearsal windows

Hi Elena — thanks for the quick note and the slides. Welcome — we’re thrilled to have you.

Quick plan and asks from our side: 

- Rehearsal: We can do Tue 2024-09-19 at 08:00 PDT / 15:00 UTC (which is 17:00 CEST) — that hits your Wed window a bit late; alternatively Wed 2024-09-20 13:00 UTC (15:00 CEST) is open and looks like the best fit for all. Please confirm which you prefer.
- Captions: We do live English captions by default; Spanish captions require an external vendor (small add-on). I’ve looped Lauren to confirm cost/booking for Spanish captions.
- Run-of-show (high level):
  1) 00:00–02:00 — Pre-show checks (greenroom opens, mics, camera)
  2) 02:00–04:00 — Host intro + lower-third + 1 short SRE demo (30s)
  3) 04:00–20:00 — Guest talk (Elena) + Q&A (12–15 min)
  4) 20:00–25:00 — Close & CTA / post-show recording handoff

Action items: Lauren will book greenroom & captions vendor if approved; Soojin will be tech lead for the live window; Karthik please coordinate the lower-third and the final slide handoff. I’ll send a Drive folder with runbook + calendar invites.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aIwk-Event-Runbook
DocuSign (speaker agreement): https://www.docusign.net/Member/Sign?d=AIWORKS-2024-09

I’ve attached our working runbook (v2).

— Marcus
Director, Events & Field Marketing, Redwood Inference
[attachment: runbook_v2.pdf (237KB)]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Dr. Elena Kovalenko <elena@aiworks.co>
Date: Sat, 14 Sep 2024 14:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Webinar — localization & rehearsal windows

Thanks — I’ll take captions + greenroom logistics.

- Greenroom: booked for Wed 2024-09-20 14:30–16:30 CEST (buffer + 60m tech window). Calendar invite sent to everyone (Elena, Tom, Marcus, Soojin). Calendar ID: cal_2734-event-redwood.
- Captions: vendor estimate for Spanish captions is attached; needs PO approval. If approved we can enable real-time Spanish captions + transcript.
- Timezone grid: attaching a small grid with windows for core team + Elena’s region. Please review.

I’ll also add the lower-third assets and confirm the slide deadline (Thursday EOD for final deck).

— Lauren
Producer, Redwood Events
[attachment: timezone-grid.csv (3KB)]

From: Dr. Elena Kovalenko <elena@aiworks.co>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: AIWorks Events <events@aiworks.co>; Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>; Tom R. <tom.r@aiworks.co>
Date: Sat, 14 Sep 2024 15:05:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Webinar — localization & rehearsal windows

Thanks Marcus & Lauren — Wed 2024-09-20 works best for us (17:00 CEST rehearsal is fine). We can confirm the final slides by Thu EOD.

Spanish captions: yes please — happy for Redwood to proceed with the vendor and we’ll cover any nominal cost if needed. Tom will upload the lower-third file by Monday.

One small ask: could the Q&A be moved to 10–12 minutes to leave a 3–5 minute buffer for wrap? If you’d like, I can prioritize one demo slide to shorten the talk by 2 minutes.

Best,
Elena

- Elena / AIWorks: please upload final slides to the Drive folder by Thu 2024-09-19 23:59 UTC. If you want to trim one demo slide to shorten Q&A we’re happy to accommodate.
- Lauren: book Spanish captions vendor and confirm PO flow by Mon 2024-09-16.
- Soojin: tech run on Wed rehearsal — confirm test URL and standby engineer.
